about: Area names for the save/load menu (QoL 5, Q10: an area names table; main lane, chat 39). Keyed by the area's ECL data set and script block ('2:20' = ECL2.DAX block 20; GEO and the wall sets share the block id). Names come from the game's own texts where any text names the area (its own script or another's, e.g. City Hall's commissions); the cluebook's map titles where none does. 'source' says which. 'confirmed': Jeremy has confirmed the name (he confirms the list first; until then the menu shows the name marked unconfirmed). The original shows no area names: this table only serves ours' additions.
